card.battery_not_numeric: The battery level entity does not report a number ({state}). Please select the battery level sensor in %.
card.description: Electric car card with a 5-segment battery, charging bolt and configurable values.
card.hint: Please select the battery level entity (entities.battery) in the editor.
editor.add_note: Select an entity to add a value.
editor.charging_note: The bolt is green while the car is charging. Its pulse and glow get stronger with higher charging power (4 levels).
editor.quick_note: Tick a value to add it. The matching entity of the selected device is filled in automatically; if none is found, pick one in the new row.
editor.values_note: General values are shown on the left, charging values on the right; other values fill up the shorter side. ⇄ moves a value to the other side.
helper.charging_state: Without a charging state, the car counts as charging while the charging power is above 0.
helper.device: Only shows the entities of this device in the pickers below and fills empty fields automatically.
helper.image: Leave empty to use the vehicle selected above.
helper.language: Language of the card and editor texts. Values are always formatted by Home Assistant.
helper.silhouette: Built-in drawing. A custom image below replaces it.
label.name: Name
language.name: English
